detail: Findings: MEASURED graph scope damage: of 242 file entities carrying a scope property, only 132 (55%) have a name that starts with that scope. The other 110 carry a scope contradicting their own path — last-writer-wins overwrites from decisions in other scopes. Entity census: 697 total, 245 file, 56 function, 379 concept; all 56 symbol entities carry a scope property.; Blast radius of wrong entity scope is bounded to relevance, not correctness. Only two consumers, both in context-assembler: getRelatedEntities (:1080) runs query(scope, limit 5) which substring-matches name OR properties with NO name filter, so a wrong scope property puts wrong files into related_entities in every assemble briefing; computeGraphReachability (:960) queries 20 candidates then filters by NAME, so a wrong scope cannot produce a wrong result there but can crowd a correct entity out of the 20 slots. Nothing does exact scope-equality filtering.; KEY ASYMMETRY for the design decision: file entity names ARE paths, so query('src/auth/') already matches 'src/auth/middleware.ts' by name regardless of the scope property — scope is redundant for files and currently wrong 45% of the time. Symbol entities have bare names ('computeGraphReachability') so scope is their only locator, though their decided_by relation to the decision entity already carries it. Any fix must answer files and symbols separately or accept redundancy on one side.; warning: MECHANISM for the Stop hook false positive, refining the earlier finding. This turn made ZERO file edits (read-only Bash and grep only) and the working tree is clean, yet the Stop hook demanded a record. A background workflow's subagents were writing scratch files to /tmp at the time. The PostToolUse activity marker fires on the Edit/Write TOOL CALL, not on whether the written path is inside the project — so a subagent writing anywhere on disk, including outside the repo entirely, trips the controlling session's gate. Fix would be to test the resolved path against the project root before marking activity.
summary: Analyzed graph entity scope semantics with measurements; identified the mechanism behind the Stop hook false positive
